ownership.quote: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) is a web service that provides secure, resizable compute capacity in the cloud, offered by Amazon Web Services, a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc.

stage.quote: Amazon.com, Inc. is a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: AMZN); AWS/EC2 is a business segment, not a separately funded entity.
stage.note: EC2 (Windows) is a feature/instance-type of AWS, itself a segment of the publicly traded Amazon.com, Inc. It has never raised independent funding; not applicable as a standalone startup stage.

revenue.as_of: 2025 (AWS segment, full year 2024 reported Q4 2025 filing basis)
revenue.basis: Amazon's 10-K / Q4 earnings release reports AWS segment net sales; figure is for the entire AWS segment (all services), not EC2 or the Windows-specific slice of EC2 alone.
revenue.quote: AWS segment sales increased 19% year-over-year to $107.6 billion in 2024.

note: AWS EC2 (Windows Server) is not an independent company: it is a compute product of Amazon Web Services, a wholly owned subsidiary of the publicly traded Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN). It has no independent funding, accelerator history, or standalone revenue disclosure; only Amazon's consolidated and AWS-segment revenue are publicly reported, and no EC2- or Windows-specific revenue breakout is published.
